title: Original NCI logical canvas
summary: Created the logical canvas used to visualize and interact with non-coherent interconnect configurations.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2025-01-14. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Created the original NCI logical canvas tooling in Interconnect Architect.
Extended logical-canvas layout, connectivity, route visualization, filtering and interaction behavior.
Original NCI/NoC canvas work is associated with the internal Tower product; AMBA is converted to generic transport at interface bridges before entering its fabric.
Extended the original NoC logical canvas with connection creation, transformed connector gestures and route-editing state tied to backend topology.
Implemented hardware-aware logical layout classification and connectivity grouping so the graph view reflects design structure rather than only physical coordinates.

notes: Original canvas ownership does not claim exclusive authorship of every later shared renderer or scene component.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
